testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/plp/verify-quick-view-for-configurable-product-with-variant3.spec.ts > PLP - Quick View for Configurable Product with Variant3 (Medium+White+Halogen) > verify quick view for configurable product with variant3

scenario.summary: Guest searches a configurable parent by SKU, checks the PLP card (name, SKU, price), opens Quick View (default variant SKU shown), selects another bulb size and technology to switch to a different variant, checks that variant's name, SKU, description, price and stock, adds it to cart and checks the cart total, the three variant attribute lines and the item price.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the parent SKU; assert card name (hdgProductName666), SKU and retail price.
Open Quick View; select Medium (asserts the default variant SKU SKU:z-2510001 is still shown) then Halogen; assert the new variant name.
Assert the selected variant's SKU, name, description, sales price (divSalesPrice669) and stock status.
Add to Cart, go to the cart; assert 'Home / Cart', 'YOUR TOTAL IS ...', attribute lines Bulb Size / Color / Technology and the item price.
stateChanges: Adds one unit of the selected variant to the guest session cart (not removed).
assertions: PLP card: parent name, SKU and price.
Quick View switches from the default variant to the selected variant: SKU, name, description, price, 'In Stock'.
Cart: total heading, attribute values of the variant, item price.
evidence: Title 'verify quick view for configurable product with variant3' and describe 'Variant3 (Medium+White+Halogen)' match the flow; guest storageState; no linked AIO cases.

Profile: parent B-100000 FOUND as ConfigurableProduct (PimProductId 666), active, PRODUCTION, brand Philips, storefrontProductIndex 1. tda rows: variant z-2510011 is PimProductId 669 (EcoSmart halogen, active); the default variant z-2510001 is PimProductId 532.

Key PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS: quantityUsed 1; minVariants 2 because the test sees the default variant first and then selects a different one (variant1Sku = default, variant2Sku = the selected one); minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0; variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology (cart shows all three attributes; same value as the checkout configurable entries).

Outputs now cover: sku -> parentProductSku, parentProductName -> name, the selected variant's name -> variant2Name and price -> variant2Price (sales, else retail); test ids with 666 from parentProductId, 669 from variant2ProductId and z-2510011 from variant2Sku. Composed values stay data without output, built by the spec: variant3SKU 'SKU:' + variant2Sku, the attribute lines '<label> : ' + variant2Attr1..3, the swatch ids imgMedium / imgHalogen from variant2Attr1..3, hdgTotalPriceWithItems 'YOUR TOTAL IS <variant2Price> For 1 Item', variant3ItemPrice '<variant2Price> / Piece'.

Not covered: the parent card price '$50.00 / Piece' stays expected-output: the parent price is an output of PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_PDP_DETAILS only (parentRetailPrice; PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS has no room for it), and that key takes no product param, so a second need could not be tied to this need's parent; the ' / Piece' unit is not produced by any key either. Also not covered: the variant description (variant3ProductDescription), which has no output in this key, and the default variant (the 'SKU:z-2510001' shown before switching): variant1Sku is the first variant by SKU, not guaranteed to be the Quick View default, and no key produces the default variant. 'In Stock' stays as recorded.

Data in code: PimProductIds 666 and 669 in test ids, the default variant SKU literal 'SKU:z-2510001' (spec line 68), the swatch ids imgMedium / imgHalogen, the variant SKU in divConfigurableProductAttributesz-2510011 and the attribute lines 'Bulb Size : Medium', 'Color : White', 'Technology : Halogen'; recorded as data of alias product.
migrate: loadData is used, but prices and the cart total depend on the record and record ids, SKUs and attribute values are in code (swap rules 3 and 4 fail).
